breakdown.description: A horizontal traction on the vertical edge x = 0 is reinterpreted as tangential shear, even though it is normal to that edge
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly states the load on x=0 as a normal traction in the +x direction ('A normal traction of 4000 Pa...'), and does not repeat the incorrect reinterpretation as tangential shear. This matches the ground truth meaning.
